def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be 2D")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must have the same shape")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty")
    if not (
        np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all()
        and np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all()
        and np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all()
    ):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be finite")
    if not (
        np.all(logp_with_result <= 0)
        and np.all(logp_call_only <= 0)
        and np.all(logp_no_call <= 0)
    ):
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must be nonpositive")
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    n, H = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute weights
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(H, dtype=float))
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted sums
    s_with = logp_with_result @ weights
    s_no = logp_no_call @ weights
    s_call = logp_call_only @ weights

    # Losses (negative log likelihood)
    L_with = -s_with
    L_no = -s_no
    L_call = -s_call

    # Margins: min of the two differences
    margin = np.minimum(L_no - L_with, L_call - L_with)
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep, margin.astype(np.float64)
